afterimage.config.title: Afterimage
afterimage.config.general.title: Afterimages
afterimage.config.general.tooltip: Fading copies left behind moving characters
afterimage.config.general.enabled-commen: Off by default. Turn on to leave afterimages for every replay that has no clip. The Afterimage clip always works, regardless of this option
afterimage.config.general.spacing-commen: How far (in blocks) a character has to move before a new afterimage is left
afterimage.config.general.hold-comment: Ticks an afterimage keeps its starting opacity before it starts to fade (20 ticks = 1 second)
afterimage.config.general.fade-comment: Ticks the fade takes, from the starting opacity down to nothing (20 ticks = 1 second)
afterimage.config.general.start_alpha-co: Opacity of a fresh afterimage: 1 is solid, lower is more see-through
afterimage.config.general.min_alpha-comm: An afterimage fainter than this is deleted
afterimage.config.general.max_ghosts-com: Most afterimages alive at once per character. Lower it if the game slows down
afterimage.config.general.trigger-commen: While the character moves, or all the time (even when standing still)
afterimage.config.general.interval-comme: Ticks between two afterimages in the all-the-time mode (20 ticks = 1 second)
afterimage.config.color.title: Afterimage colour
afterimage.config.color.tooltip: The colour of the afterimages: the character's own, one colour, a gradient, two colours in turn, or a rainbow
afterimage.config.color.color_mode-comme: Original, one solid colour, a gradient over the life of each afterimage, two colours in turn, or a rainbow
afterimage.config.color.color1-comment: The colour of the solid mode and the start of the gradient and the turns
afterimage.config.color.color2-comment: The end of the gradient and the second colour of the turns
afterimage.config.color.strength-comment: 0 keeps the character's own colours, 1 paints the afterimage fully in the chosen colour
afterimage.config.color.rainbow_step-com: How far the hue moves on from one afterimage to the next (1 = a full turn of the rainbow)
afterimage.config.color.rainbow_life-com: Hue turns per second over the life of every afterimage. 0 keeps each one in a single colour
afterimage.config.motion.title: Afterimage motion
afterimage.config.motion.tooltip: Makes the afterimages drift away while they fade
afterimage.config.motion.drift_direction: Right, left, forward and back are the character's own, up and down are the world's
afterimage.clip.target.tooltip: Replay id. Empty means all replays
afterimage.clip.always.tooltip: On: ghosts spawn constantly, off: only while moving
